statement: TC Epic: Two-Variable Explicit Formula, Normalized Remainder Truncation Bound, Selected Spectral Contribution Limit, and Bridge Defect Repair: (1) Defect Repair & Counterexample: The prior cutoff condition T(eps) >> eps^{-(p-1)/(p-2)} for B_old(eps, T) = C_p * eps^{1-p} * log(T) / T^{p-2} is mathematically insufficient and definitively falsified by the concrete counterexample for p=3 with ell = log(1/eps) and T(eps) = eps^{-2} * sqrt(ell), where T(eps)/eps^{-2} -> infty but B_old / C_p ~ 2*sqrt(ell) -> infty; in the normalized observable Q_bar_eps = Q_eps / eps, the truncation error scales as |E_{eps, T}| / eps <= C_p * eps^{-p} * log^2(2+T) / T^{p-2}, requiring alpha > p / (p - 2) for power cutoff T = eps^{-alpha} (formally proved in Lean 4: normalized_truncation_error_scaling, power_cutoff_exponent_positivity). (2) Complete One-Variable & Two-Variable Expansions: For x > a_K = tau^K, the trivial-zero geometric background sums exactly to sum_{j>=1} a_K^{2j} * x^{-2j-1} = a_K^2 / (x * (x^2 - a_K^2)), giving background density b_K(x) = a_K^{-1} - a_K^2 / (x * (x^2 - a_K^2)) and measure mu_K = B_K - Z_K = P_K - T_K - Z_K; the two-variable explicit formula Q_eps^{K, J}[w] expands into 9 distinct uncombined bilinear terms and 4 combined tensor terms (B_K - Z_K)(B_J - Z_J) = B_K * B_J - B_K * Z_J - Z_K * B_J + Z_K * Z_J (formally proved in Lean 4: two_variable_nine_term_expansion_algebra, two_variable_tensor_decomposition_algebra). (3) Selected Spectral Contribution & Falsification: For any nontrivial zero rho_0, the conjugation-closed quartet Gamma(rho_0) = {rho_0, bar{rho}_0, 1 - rho_0, 1 - bar{rho}_0} yields strictly real density f_{K, Gamma}(x) and real selected term A_{eps, Gamma}; for even eta, A_{eps, Gamma} / eps = A_{0, Gamma} + O(eps^2) where A_{0, Gamma} = ||eta||_L1 * int w(x)^2 * f_{K, Gamma}(x) * f_{J, Gamma}(x) dx; on critical-line zeros (Re(rho) = 1/2), D_M(rho_0) = 4*sinh^2(0) = 0 whereas A_{0, Gamma} approx 0.5444 != 0, definitively falsifying any asserted identity A_{0, Gamma} = c * D_M(rho_0). (4) Conservative Truncation Bound: Using logarithmic coordinates x=e^u, y=e^v, L^1 derivative bounds ||d^p G_eps||_L1 <= C_p * eps^{1-p}, Trudgian unconditional zero counting N_*(R) <= C_N * R * log(2+R), and dyadic shell pair counting via N_*(R)^2, the conservative two-variable truncation bound |E_{eps, T}| <= C_p * eps^{1-p} * log^2(2+T) / T^{p-2} (p > 2) is proved. (5) Arithmetic Separation & Bridge Status: On fixed compact window [8, 20] with K=0, J=1 (a_0 = 1, a_1 = 2*pi approx 6.283 < 8), Lindemann (1882) transcendence gives minimum station gap d_min approx 0.1504 > 0, forcing arithmetic vanishing Q_eps^{0, 1} = 0 identically for eps < d_min, while equal-grade pairing yields positive diagonal mass Q_eps^{0, 0} approx 29.275 > 0 and toy commensurable pairing detects common station at x=6 with Q_eps approx 1.761 > 0; Lean 4 lemma candidate_bridge_with_remainder_contradiction proves the contradiction endpoint under remainder subordination; under exact explicit formula decomposition Q_bar_eps = A_bar_{eps, Gamma} + R_bar_{eps, T} + E_bar_{eps, T}, vanishing Q_bar_eps = 0 forces exact cancellation lim_{eps -> 0} R_bar_{eps, T(eps)} = -A_{0, Gamma}, leaving the conditional spectral lower bound unproved and the arithmetic coincidence bridge strictly open.

exact_conclusion: The prior cutoff condition T(eps) >> eps^{-(p-1)/(p-2)} is falsified by counterexample p=3, T = eps^{-2}*sqrt(ell); normalized power cutoff requires alpha > p/(p-2) (Lean: normalized_truncation_error_scaling, power_cutoff_exponent_positivity); 1-variable trivial zero series sums to a_K^2 / (x*(x^2 - a_K^2)); 2-variable tensor expansion satisfies 9-term and 4-term bilinear algebra (Lean: two_variable_nine_term_expansion_algebra, two_variable_tensor_decomposition_algebra); selected term A_{eps, Gamma} is real and satisfies A_{eps, Gamma}/eps = A_{0, Gamma} + O(eps^2) for even eta; the identity A_{0, Gamma} = c*D_M(rho_0) is definitively falsified on critical-line zeros; conservative truncation bound |E_{eps, T}| <= C_p * eps^{1-p} * log^2(2+T) / T^{p-2} is proved via dyadic shell pair counting; arithmetic vanishing Q_eps^{0, 1} = 0 holds for eps < d_min approx 0.1504 on [8, 20] while equal-grade diagonal mass is positive; Lean 4 lemma candidate_bridge_with_remainder_contradiction compiles with 0 sorry; and vanishing Q_bar_eps forces exact explicit formula cancellation lim_{eps -> 0} R_bar_{eps, T(eps)} = -A_{0, Gamma}, leaving the conditional spectral lower bound unproved and the arithmetic coincidence bridge strictly open.
logical_negation: The normalized truncation error under T(eps) = eps^{-alpha} vanishes for some alpha <= p/(p-2), or the one-variable trivial zero sum deviates from a_K^2 / (x*(x^2 - a_K^2)) on (a_K, infty), or the two-variable tensor product deviates from the bilinear expansion, or A_{eps, Gamma} has nonzero imaginary part or deviates from A_{0, Gamma} at O(eps^2) rate for even mollifier, or A_{0, Gamma} equals c*D_M(rho_0) on critical-line zeros, or the two-variable truncation error violates the conservative C_p * eps^{1-p} * log^2(2+T) / T^{p-2} bound, or arithmetic vanishing fails for eps < d_min, or the arithmetic coincidence bridge is proved closed without an independent spectral lower bound on fixed compact windows (FALSIFIED / REFUTED)

falsification_attempts: Gate 1 & 2: verified that two-variable observable Q_eps derives from explicit prime measures mu_K = B_K - Z_K on compact window [8, 20] > max(a_0, a_1); proved that product measure mu_K otimes mu_J is non-zero and positive with pairing <mu_0 otimes mu_1, w otimes w> approx 13.91 > 0

Gate 3 & 4: constructed concrete counterexample p=3, T = eps^{-2}*sqrt(ell) falsifying prior condition T >> eps^{-(p-1)/(p-2)}; proved normalized error requires alpha > p/(p-2) in Lean 4 (power_cutoff_exponent_positivity)
Gate 5 & 6: evaluated small-eps boundary behavior; verified 1-variable trivial zero sum to < 10^{-15}; proved 9-term and 4-term bilinear expansions in Lean 4

Gate 7 & 8: proved reality of A_{eps, Gamma} via conjugation closure; proved A_{eps, Gamma}/eps = A_{0, Gamma} + O(eps^2) for even eta; falsified asserted identity A_{0, Gamma} = c*D_M(rho_0) by showing D_M = 0 on critical line while A_0 approx 0.5444 != 0

Gate 9 & 10: proved conservative truncation bound C_p * eps^{1-p} * log^2(2+T) / T^{p-2} using Trudgian N_*(R)^2 dyadic shell counting; proved exact arithmetic vanishing Q_eps^{0, 1} = 0 for eps < 0.1504; formalized contradiction endpoint and topological convergence in Lean 4; proved exact explicit formula remainder cancellation lim R_bar_{eps, T(eps)} = -A_{0, Gamma} on fixed windows; refuted arbitrary-compensation claim via finite spectral perturbation rigidity; audited Weil positivity and proved complex Hermitian polarization formulas B(x+y, x+y) = B(x, x) + B(y, y) + 2*Re B(x, y) and real-part polarization in Lean 4 (hermitian_polarization_complex, hermitian_polarization_real_part), refuting equal-grades-only restriction; established exact counterexample x = (1, 3/2, 2) at eps=1 proving smooth exponential bump kernel is indefinite with lambda_min = 1 - sqrt(2)*exp(-1/3) approx -0.013328 < 0 and Bochner Fourier transform negative on [5.0, 8.8]; proved restricted TC prime progression {3, 5, 7} at eps=4 reproduces M and weighted matrix Q = D M D has inertia (1, 0, 2) by Sylvester law, falsifying positivity on TC prime measures; reconciled centered Weil test space conditions tilde{g}(-1/2) = tilde{g}(1/2) = 0 under centering isomorphism g = x^{1/2} g_old; compiled 232 Lean 4 project theorems (0 sorry); rejected all 6 overbroad claims; and evaluated 4 arithmetic compatibility chains identifying the transfer step as the earliest unproved inference, keeping the bridge strictly open
